ms-sos-2026-sl-qualifying-list.title: Candidate Qualifying List: state offices (CandidateQualifying.csv)
ms-sos-2026-sl-qualifying-list.note: Shown on https://www.sos.ms.gov/elections-voting/candidate-qualifying-list, "All offices and candidates currently on file"; read through the page's own Download CSV button and checked, heading by heading, against the tables on the page. Only Office, Candidate Name, Party, District, Place and the election dates are read (the file has no contact columns). The SHA-256 is the CSV's as downloaded; only the kept columns are cached. Used to confirm the sample ballot's candidates seat by seat. The list has no status column (a candidate who withdrew may simply stop being listed) and lists no write-in candidates; candidates it names who are not on the sample ballot are not stored: 2026-MS-CH20-P1: Jon Heath Powell; 2026-MS-CC20-P1: Martin Bradley Mills; it has a heading with no candidate under it: Candidates for Mississippi Circuit Court Judge Special Election.

ms-sos-2026-sl-sample-ballot.title: SAMPLE Official Election Ballot, State of Mississippi: Federal and Judicial Election, Tuesday, November 3, 2026
ms-sos-2026-sl-sample-ballot.note: Linked as "Sample Ballot" from https://www.sos.ms.gov/elections-voting. The state contests only (the federal ones are the federal pages'), read column by column: the names, party words and order are the ballot's own, and ballot_order is the position on this statewide sample. Every contest leaves a Write-in line; no declared write-in candidates are listed. 128 state contests: special elections for two House seats and a district attorney, and the nonpartisan judicial elections (Court of Appeals, chancery and circuit courts).
